limits: Rendered PDF page9 has the correct not-equal/non-triangle signs that text extraction drops.

The page14 strict-concavity iff negative Hessian display is not a necessary condition for all strictly concave smooth functions and must exclude the zero direction. Use negative-definite Hessian as a sufficient condition on a convex domain.

The page15 score equation requires an interior attained optimum; strict concavity alone does not establish existence. The open Bernoulli/Poisson parameter spaces on pages17–18 also have zero-count/boundary existence exceptions.

Page24 explicitly leaves additional technical conditions unspecified. The chapter must supply compact measurable selection, uniform convergence, local Hessian and moment hypotheses rather than claim the slide gives a complete proof.
